articles.summary: Runway has launched Gen-4, a cutting-edge AI video generator poised to redefine video production. With advanced features and improved consistency, this model eliminates extra training with its visual references and text prompts. While facing competition and a lawsuit, Runway targets a $4 billion valuation, stirring debates on job impact in the film industry.
articles.title: Runway Unleashes Gen-4: A Game-Changer in AI Video Generation
